answer: Require every agent to lock a cedar-sized stake, a refundable deposit tied to one verified identity, before it can trade. A reputation mirror then publishes each agent's full history, so a fake identity starts with zero trust and cannot hide past fraud. Sybils must fund a fresh stake for every voyage into the market, and slashing burns the deposit of any identity caught cheating, making mass fake accounts cost more than they can ever earn back.
